hero.title: Agents and automations that take repetitive work off your team's plate.
hero.promise: Most companies don't need "more AI" — they need to know which processes to automate first and to see one running end to end. That's exactly what we do: an honest assessment, a measurable pilot, and, when it makes sense, ongoing operation.

items.title: AI opportunity assessment
items.body: A 2-week diagnostic: we map your processes and prioritize where automation actually pays.

items.title: AI agents
items.body: Assistants that read email, classify requests, draft responses, and execute tasks inside your systems.

items.title: Chatbots on your knowledge
items.body: Customer and internal support with answers grounded in your documents and policies — not made up.

items.title: Process automation
items.body: Flows across your tools — invoicing, CRM, inventory, reporting — without copy-pasting between screens.

items.title: Integration with your systems
items.body: We connect AI to Microsoft 365, Odoo, HubSpot, or your ERP through APIs, with permissions and auditing.

items.title: Measurement and control
items.body: Every automation ships with usage, cost, and error-rate metrics. If it can't be measured, it doesn't ship.

how.caption: A real flow: a request arrives by email, an agent classifies it, queries your system, and replies — with a human approving what matters.

tiers.name: AI Opportunity Assessment
tiers.blurb: Fixed-scope, 2-week diagnostic: process map, use cases ranked by return, and an automation roadmap ready to execute.

tiers.name: Automation Pilot
tiers.blurb: One process automated end to end, in production, with metrics. Concrete proof that this works in your operation.

tiers.name: AI Partner
tiers.blurb: Monthly retainer: we build and operate your agents and automations, with continuous improvements and support.

items.q: Is my company too small for AI?
items.a: If your team does repetitive computer work — answering similar emails, moving data between systems, assembling reports — there's a use case. Size matters less than the volume of repeatable work; the assessment tells you whether the return justifies the investment.

items.q: What about the confidentiality of my data?
items.a: We define from day one which data may leave your company and which may not. We use business accounts with no-training agreements, and when the case demands it, models deployed in your own cloud.
It does — which is why every flow includes human approval points where errors are costly, and visible error-rate metrics. We automate the fault-tolerant, low-risk work first.

items.q: How fast do we see results?
items.a: The assessment takes 2 weeks. A typical pilot is in production 3 to 6 weeks later. You should see hours recovered in the chosen process within the first month.

hero.title: Your IT department, without having to build one.
hero.promise: Support that answers, computers that work, backups that actually restore, and a network that stays up. We run your technology to big-company standards, at a fraction of the cost of an internal team.

items.title: Helpdesk
items.body: Remote support for your team, with agreed response times and follow-through on every case until it's closed.

items.title: Microsoft 365
items.body: Email, Teams, SharePoint, and licensing managed: onboarding, offboarding, security, and good practices from day one.

items.title: Networking & firewall
items.body: Design, installation, and management of your network and firewall (FortiGate), with secure VPN for remote work.

items.title: Backups & continuity
items.body: Automatic backups of servers and critical machines, proven with real restores — not just green lights.

items.title: Patching & maintenance
items.body: System and application updates applied on time, before an old vulnerability becomes an incident.

items.title: Proactive monitoring
items.body: We watch disks, services, and backups 24/7; many failures get fixed before anyone notices.

how.caption: What a quiet month looks like: tickets resolved within SLA, patches current, and backups verified with a test restore.

tiers.name: Essential
tiers.blurb: Helpdesk, Microsoft 365, and managed patching. The baseline for running without surprises, per seat per month.

tiers.name: Complete

tiers.name: Premium
tiers.blurb: Adds proactive monitoring, a security baseline, and a quarterly IT roadmap with the founders.

items.a: Every plan has response times agreed in writing by severity. A down workstation doesn't wait like a printer does; urgent issues get attention in minutes, not days.

items.q: We already have someone who "knows computers". Why change?
items.a: Because your operation depends on that person being available, documenting things, and knowing security. We leave everything documented, monitored, and backed by a team — and we answer under a service agreement, not as a favor.

items.q: Do I have to replace my current equipment or licenses?
items.a: Not up front. We start with a diagnostic of what you have; what works, stays. Investments are proposed with priority and budget, and you make the call.

items.q: Do you work with US-based teams?
items.a: Yes — that's the point of being in Barranquilla: we operate on US Eastern hours with native bilingual communication, at nearshore rates. Remote-first, with the same standards a US MSP would offer.

hero.title: Real security, and a clear path to SOC 2 / ISO 27001.
hero.promise: No fear-selling, no empty checklists: we harden your infrastructure, manage vulnerabilities continuously, and — when your customers demand certifications — take you all the way to the audit with real evidence.

items.title: Infrastructure hardening
items.body: Secure configuration of servers, endpoints, Microsoft 365, and network: MFA, encryption, least privilege, and documented baselines.

items.title: Vulnerability management
items.body: Periodic scanning, risk-based prioritization, and verified remediation — a continuous cycle, not an annual PDF.

items.title: SOC 2 / ISO 27001 readiness
items.body: Gap assessment, remediation plan, and evidence support until you pass the audit.

items.title: Identity & email protection
items.body: The entry point for 90% of attacks — phishing, compromised accounts, misconfigured access — closed.

items.title: Incident response
items.body: A tested plan for when something happens: containment, communication, and recovery without improvising.

items.title: Security awareness
items.body: Short, recurring training for your people, because the best firewall doesn't fix a hasty click.

how.caption: A real review: every control with its status and its evidence. This is how a prepared company walks into a SOC 2 audit.

tiers.name: Security Baseline
tiers.blurb: Infrastructure hardening, vulnerability scan, and an executive report with clear priorities. The starting point.

tiers.name: SOC 2 / ISO 27001 Readiness
tiers.blurb: Gap assessment against the standard, remediation plan, and evidence support through the audit.

tiers.name: vCISO
tiers.blurb: Security as an ongoing function: risk management, periodic reviews, and a security lead without a full-time hire.

items.q: Would anyone really attack a company my size?
items.a: Mass attacks don't pick victims: they scan the internet and exploit whatever is open. SMBs are the most frequent target precisely because they tend to be less protected.

items.q: How long does SOC 2 readiness take?
items.a: It depends on the starting point; typically 3 to 6 months from gap assessment to audit-ready. The initial assessment gives you an honest timeline within the first week.
No — the audit is always performed by an independent third party. We prepare your infrastructure, policies, and evidence so you walk into that audit to pass it, not to discover problems.
It costs a fraction of what an incident does: the ransom, the days down, the customers lost. We start with the baseline — the essentials done right — and grow from there based on your actual risk.

hero.title: Software that fits your operation, not the other way around.
hero.promise: When the spreadsheet can't take any more and off-the-shelf software forces you to work its way, we build the exact tool: web applications, APIs, and integrations that talk to what you already use.

items.title: Web applications
items.body: Internal portals, operations dashboards, and customer tools built in React and Next.js — fast and easy to use.

items.title: APIs & backends
items.body: Services in FastAPI and Node: solid, documented, and ready to grow with your operation.

items.title: Integrations
items.body: Your systems talking to each other — ERP, CRM, billing, logistics — without manual reconciliation in Excel.

items.title: System modernization
items.body: That old system everyone depends on and nobody wants to touch: we migrate it piece by piece, without stopping the operation.

items.title: AI-enabled software
items.body: Smart search, automatic classification, or assistants inside your own tool — where they add value.

items.title: Operation & evolution
items.body: We don't deliver and disappear: we monitor, fix, and evolve the software on a monthly retainer.

how.caption: Real code: a typed, tested, documented API — the standard for every delivery.

tiers.name: Discovery Sprint
tiers.blurb: Fixed price: we understand the problem, prototype the solution, and deliver a plan with scope and budget. You decide on facts.

tiers.name: Project
tiers.blurb: Defined-scope build with biweekly milestones and working demos — you see real progress, not progress reports.

tiers.name: Evolution Retainer
tiers.blurb: Monthly hours to operate, improve, and extend your software with the same team that built it.

items.q: Why not just buy off-the-shelf software?
items.a: If a market product solves your case, we'll tell you — it's cheaper, and we'll implement it. Building custom makes sense when your process is your competitive edge, or when the generic tool forces you to deform your operation.

items.q: How do I know it won't become a never-ending project?
items.a: The discovery sprint defines scope and budget before serious code gets written, and the project moves in biweekly milestones with working demos. If something drifts, you see it in two weeks — not six months.
Yes. All code, documentation, and access are in your name from day one. If you want to work with another team tomorrow, you take everything with you.
Software needs operation: dependencies to update, bugs to fix, improvements to prioritize. That's what the evolution retainer is for — or we train your team to run it.

aiAssistant.name: AI Virtual Receptionist
aiAssistant.tagline: Answers every call, captures the lead, and books the meeting — in a natural voice.

hero.title: No call goes unanswered again.
hero.promise: An AI receptionist that picks up your sales line in seconds, in a natural voice: it answers questions from your company's information, captures the caller's details into your CRM, warm-transfers to your team during business hours, and books meetings when nobody's in.

features.title: Answers every call
features.body: Every inbound call is attended instantly, during business hours or at midnight — no more full voicemail boxes and lost leads.

features.title: Answers from your knowledge
features.body: Its knowledge base is built from your own website and data, and refreshes automatically every week.

features.title: Captures leads into your CRM
features.body: Name, company, interest, and phone are logged in HubSpot, with the call transcript attached as an activity.

features.title: Warm transfer
features.body: During business hours, it detects when a call deserves a human and transfers it to your sales team with context.

features.title: Books after hours
features.body: When your team is out, it offers and books a meeting on the team's real calendar, with email confirmation.

features.title: Secure by design
features.body: Every integration call is signed and verified, transcripts are purged automatically, and failures degrade gracefully — the conversation never drops.

built.title: Real telephony, real AI.
built.body: Business telephony connected to a Claude-powered voice agent, a dedicated FastAPI backend that performs real actions — CRM, calendar, Teams notifications — and a knowledge base synced from your site. Configuration as code, tested end to end.

whatsapp.name: WhatsApp AI Assistant
whatsapp.tagline: A real conversational agent that takes orders and reservations on WhatsApp.

hero.title: Your WhatsApp answers, sells, and books. On its own.
hero.promise: Built for restaurants and hotels: an AI agent that genuinely converses — no button menus. It consults your menu or services, takes orders, manages reservations, answers questions from your own information, and hands the conversation to your team when needed.

features.title: Real conversation, not buttons
features.body: It understands what customers write — or say: voice notes are transcribed automatically, because that's how customers actually message.

features.title: Takes orders and reservations
features.body: Consults the menu or services, builds the order, books the reservation, and records it — real actions on your data, not just replies.

features.title: Answers from your information
features.body: Prices, hours, policies, and availability come from your own knowledge base; what it doesn't know, it escalates.

features.title: Human handoff
features.body: It detects when a person should step in and flags the conversation for your team, full history in view.

features.title: Admin panel
features.body: Onboarding, bot content, and support metrics in a dedicated web panel: you control what the assistant knows and does.

features.title: Bilingual and multi-location
features.body: Serves customers in Spanish and English and supports multiple brands or locations with strict data isolation between them.

built.title: A real product, in production.
built.body: A multi-tenant SaaS platform: WhatsApp layer on Evolution API and the official WhatsApp Business API, an Anthropic Claude agent with tool use, RAG on PostgreSQL with pgvector, Redis queues, and a React panel — with cross-tenant data-isolation tests included.

itSuite.name: IT Management Suite & RMM
itSuite.tagline: Inventory, patching, remote control, and backup — one agent, one panel.

hero.title: Your entire fleet, governed from one panel.
hero.promise: A modular endpoint-management platform in the NinjaOne / Endpoint Central category: a lightweight agent on every computer and server delivers inventory, patching, remote control, software deployment, backup, and security evidence — with a security architecture uncommon in its class.

features.title: Inventory with history
features.body: Hardware and software for every endpoint, with change history, dynamic device groups, fleet-wide software search, and CSV exports.

features.title: Cross-OS patching
features.body: OS and third-party updates on Windows, Linux, and macOS, with approval workflows.

features.title: Remote control & deployment
features.body: Unattended administrative remote sessions and per-OS software package distribution.

features.title: SOC 2 evidence
features.body: Centralized logon and privileged-action logs with audited 365-day retention and auditor-ready exports.

features.title: Credential vault
features.body: Envelope-encrypted secrets (AES-256-GCM), decrypted only at use, with audited checkout and a required reason.

features.title: Living IT documentation
features.body: Versioned runbooks and typed records of networks, services, and vendors, linked to real assets.

built.title: Platform security, not brochure security.
built.body: Multi-tenant with database-level isolation, Ed25519-signed jobs the agent verifies before executing, an outbound-only mTLS channel, a hash-chained audit log, and a single Go agent for Windows, Linux, and macOS. Dogfooded on our own fleet first, designed to be commercialized.

visitorIntel.name: Website Visitor Intelligence
visitorIntel.tagline: Know which companies visit your site — qualified accounts in your inbox every morning.

hero.title: Your site gets buyers who never write. Now they land in your inbox.
hero.promise: A self-hosted, first-party account-intelligence system: it identifies the company behind each visit, interprets the behavior with AI, scores it against your ideal customer profile, and emails your sales team a daily report of the accounts worth a call.

features.title: Company identification
features.body: Resolves the company behind the visit and enriches it with industry, size, and executive contacts.

features.title: AI analysis
features.body: AI interprets the journey — pages, time, return visits — and writes an actionable brief for each account.

features.title: Scoring against your ICP
features.body: Every account is scored against your ideal customer profile: your team calls the best fit first.

features.title: Daily report to sales
features.body: An email every morning with the qualified accounts — HTML, Excel, and PDF ready to work or import into the CRM.

features.title: Contact-form funnel
features.body: Measures who opens your contact form, how far they get, and where they abandon — without ever reading what they type.

features.title: Compliance by design
features.body: First-party collection with consent, real-time privacy-signal honoring, raw IP discarded after lookup, and no session recording.

built.title: Sales intelligence, not surveillance.
built.body: A dedicated collector, an enrichment pipeline (IP → company → firmographics → contacts), Claude analysis, an account dashboard, and a report scheduler — a self-hosted stack that runs on a single server, multi-site from birth.

features.title: AI sales agent
features.body: A conversational salesperson inside the store: it guides, recommends, and walks the customer through the purchase end to end.

features.title: A complete store
features.body: A fast storefront with catalog, variants, cart, and checkout — the solid base of a serious sales operation.

features.title: Multi-store by birth
features.body: Several brands or stores on one platform, each with isolated data and its own visual identity — down to the typography.

features.title: Merchant panel
features.body: Products, orders, and customers managed from a dedicated admin application.

features.title: Pluggable payments
features.body: A swappable payment-provider architecture, ready to adapt to each market's payment methods.

features.title: Engineering that holds
features.body: A TypeScript monorepo with a dedicated API, a typed database schema, and automated tests against real databases.

built.title: Built as a product, not a template.
built.body: A Turborepo monorepo: Next.js 15 storefront and admin, NestJS API, PostgreSQL with Prisma and a tenant-scoped client, Redis, and containerized deployment — Novieri's own development end to end.

matterFlow.name: Matter Flow
matterFlow.tagline: Cases, tasks, and documents of your professional practice, flowing in order.

hero.title: Every case moves forward. Nothing falls through.
hero.promise: Matter Flow organizes the work of professional-services teams: every matter with its owner, deadlines, documents, and history — and workflows that move work forward on their own, stage by stage.

features.title: Case management
features.body: Every matter with its status, owner, deadlines, and priority — visible to the whole team.

features.title: Stage-based workflows
features.body: Define the path a case follows in your practice and let the board show exactly where each one stands.

features.title: Documents where they belong
features.body: Each case's files live with the case — not in somebody's inbox.

features.title: Tasks and deadlines
features.body: Clear assignments with reminders; due dates stop depending on memory.

features.title: Full history
features.body: Who did what and when, on every case — traceability for clients and audits.

features.title: AI automation
features.body: Incoming requests classified automatically and case summaries generated on demand.

built.title: Operational order, turned into software.
built.body: Developed by Novieri for operations that live on managing cases and commitments, with AI applied where it saves real hours.

monitoring.name: Networks & Systems Monitoring
monitoring.tagline: Network, server, and ISP observability — SolarWinds-class, without the invoice.

hero.title: See your infrastructure the way a NOC does.
hero.promise: An observability platform in three pieces: a cloud control plane, a network collector that watches what the cloud can't reach — SNMP, hosts, databases — and a lightweight agent that also measures your internet links' quality, hop by hop and per carrier.

features.title: Network devices
features.body: Switches, firewalls, UPS units, and controllers monitored over SNMP and ICMP, with assisted discovery and clear states: up, warning, critical, down.

features.title: Per-path ISP quality
features.body: Hop-by-hop latency and packet loss, grouped by carrier — hard evidence for claims against your provider, PingPlotter-style.

features.title: Servers and databases
features.body: Metrics from Windows and Linux hosts and your database engines, collected by the same agent.

features.title: Alerts with judgment
features.body: Severity-based rules with hysteresis — no alert storms — and notification to email, Slack, or Teams.

features.title: Live dashboards
features.body: A NOC-style summary with states, availability, and hardware health; per-domain dashboards for network, clouds, and databases.

features.title: Quality reports
features.body: PDF network-suitability reports — for remote desktop, VoIP, or web — by site, city, and carrier.

built.title: Born in a real multi-site operation.
built.body: Designed for an operation of hundreds of agents across countries with dual ISPs: Go collector and agent that only dial out, queued ingestion, metrics in a time-series database, and a React console — multi-tenant from day one.

sentinel.name: Sentinel — Vulnerability Management
sentinel.tagline: Discover, detect, prioritize with AI, and prove progress — on your own network.

hero.title: Know your vulnerabilities before someone else finds them.
hero.promise: A self-hosted vulnerability-management dashboard: it discovers the assets on your network, scans them with established engines in safe mode, joins findings with live threat intelligence, and uses AI to prioritize and explain — in plain language — what to fix first and how.

features.title: Asset discovery
features.body: A continuous inventory of what actually lives on your network — only within authorized scope, guaranteed in code.

features.title: Detection with proven engines
